sentences.en: Hepatology Digest: Cholestatic liver disease is a rare chronic liver disease. Would you please give us a brief introduction about its pathogenesis?

sentences.en: Cholestatic disorders cause elevated cholesterol and lipid levels, thereby leading to xanthoma formation.
sentences.vi: Rối loạn ứ mật làm cho mức cholesterol và lipid tăng cao, do đó dẫn đến hình thành xanthoma.
